Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an in situ strategy where SbF₃ both initiates cationic ring-opening polymerization of PTHF and reacts with Li to form a Li₃Sb/LiF hybrid network, eliminating pre-synthesized fillers. This enables an ultrathin (~5 µm) electrolyte with high ionic conductivity and Li⁺ transference number, suppressing dendrites and enabling durable, foldable solid-state Li metal batteries.

ژل الکترولیت خودترمیم‌شونده حاوی گلیسرول با تنظیم محیط پیوند هیدروژنی، خوردگی روی و دندریت را سرکوب کرده و چرخه‌پذیری باتری آبی Zn را پایدار می‌کند.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a glycerol-regulated, cytocompatible self-healing gel electrolyte (PVA/PEG matrix) that reshapes hydrogen bonding and Zn²⁺ coordination to suppress corrosion and dendrites, enabling 3300 h Zn plating/stripping and durable Zn–S pouch cells. Its significance is combining anode stabilization with mechanical adaptability and low cytotoxicity, advancing safe, sustainable quasi-solid-state aqueous batteries.
🏷 zinc anode · gel electrolyte · self-healing · aqueous battery · Zn-S cell

item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a facile solid-state post-treatment achieving synergistic Ce³⁺ doping and CeO₂ coating on commercial NCM811. Its significance: concurrently boosts cycling stability (82.04% vs 74.10% retention after 500 cycles) and safety by suppressing oxygen/gas release and delaying thermal runaway, offering a scalable, practical route for next-generation high-energy lithium-ion batteries.

item.title: Multicomponent Molecular Editing of Polybutadiene: From Design Space to Battery Function
item.description:
ویرایش مولکولی چندجزئی پلی‌بوتادین یک کتابخانه پلیمری می‌سازد و افزودنی P11 رفتار ردکس گوگرد و کارایی کولمبی در باتری Li-S را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces electrophilic multicomponent molecular editing of polybutadiene, creating an 18-member library that maps structure–property–function relationships. It links subtle molecular variations to thermal, morphological, and dynamic properties, guiding selection of P11 as a Li–S battery electrolyte additive. The study demonstrates library-guided design, though P11 shows trade-offs rather than optimized performance.

item.title: Stabilizing Oxygen Redox via Li Dopants Into P2‐Type Cathodes for High‐Voltage Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
دوپه‌کردن Li در کاتد P2-Na0.67Ni0.33Mn0.67O2 با تنظیم محیط هم‌آرایی، ردکس اکسیژن را پایدار کرده و پایداری چرخه در ولتاژ بالا را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Li doping regulates oxygen redox in P2-type Na0.67Ni0.33Mn0.67O2 by tuning local coordination and charge compensation, enhancing Ni redox activity while moderating TM-O coupling. 18O isotope labeling confirms suppressed lattice oxygen loss and electrolyte decomposition. The doped cathode delivers 116.6 mAh/g with 80% retention after 400 cycles versus 27% undoped, establishing a strategy to decouple oxygen redox from degradation for high-voltage sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · P2-type cathode · oxygen redox · Li doping · high-voltage cathode
